about_subtitle: A community-maintained continuation of the original Axiom AI Aimbot project. For questions, suggestions, or to share models and configs, feel free to join our Discord server.
always_auto_fire: Always Auto Fire (No Trigger Key Required)
gpu_monitoring_hint: Show NVIDIA GPU sensors in the status panel (needs an NVIDIA GPU and driver)
gpu_monitoring_no_nvml: NVML module not found: the bundled pynvml (src/python/dependencies) is missing, so reinstall or update Axiom
gpu_monitoring_no_gpu: NVML is installed, but no NVIDIA GPU or driver was found
gpu_sensors_hint: Choose which GPU readings are shown. Unsupported ones stay hidden.
gpu_refresh_hint: How often the GPU sensors are read
capture_fps_limit_desc: Maximum captures per second. For UDP/UVC, set this to your stream's FPS.
model_trt_badge_legend: ✓ = TensorRT engine already cached  ·  ⬇ = needs a one-time build (1-5 min)
detect_range_note: Note: Performance usage is the same regardless of the value.
fov_reduce_on_target_desc: Temporarily shrink the FOV while a target is locked, so a random target near the edge of the FOV can't steal the lock mid-engagement.
fov_min_size_pct_desc: How much to shrink the FOV to, as a percentage of FOV Width/Height, while a target is locked
fov_min_size_duration_desc: How long it takes the FOV to gradually shrink down to FOV Min Size after a target is acquired, then holds there for the rest of the engagement (0 = shrinks instantly)
weapon_detection_threshold_desc: Minimum confidence for ONNX weapon detections
head: Head
aim_start_delay_desc: Wait this long after aiming engages before the mouse starts moving (0 = instant)
arduino_connect_desc: Select COM port then click to connect
makcu_connect_desc: Select COM port then click to connect
makcu_transport_desc: UDP needs a MAKXD on Ethernet/Wi-Fi with plaintext UDP (encrypted UDP is not supported)
makcu_udp_address_desc: IP address and UDP port of the MAKXD
makcu_device_hotkeys_desc: Aim, toggle and auto-fire keys also react to the MAKCU's mouse/keyboard (for 2-PC setups; keyboard keys need V4/MAKXD firmware)
makcu_lock_physical_move_desc: Block your own mouse movement while a target is locked; released automatically if aiming stalls
makcu_mouse_spread_enable_desc: Apply the firmware's own mouse spread live (V4/MAKXD only; not saved to the device)
show_console_desc: Log window. The app keeps running while text in this window is selected.
status_panel_elements_hint: Choose which items are shown in the status panel
single_target_mode: Single Target Mode (Lock on the nearest enemy at a time)
spoof_confirm_msg:
This will modify your Arduino IDE settings (boards.txt) to verify Arduino Leonardo as a Logitech mouse.

A backup will be created.
Do you want to continue?
spoof_success_msg: boards.txt has been modified successfully!\n\nPlease RESTART your Arduino IDE and re-upload the firmware.
test_heart_confirm_msg: This will control the mouse to draw a heart. Please ensure there is enough space around the mouse. \n\nContinue?
update_available_content:
New version {new_version} detected. Would you like to download it?

Current Version: v{current_version}
wizard_welcome_subtitle: Let's take a moment to complete the basic setup.
wizard_theme_subtitle: Select the visual style you prefer.
wizard_acrylic_subtitle: Acrylic blur creates a layered, translucent look. Disable on low-end GPUs for better performance.
idle_detect_enabled: Reduce Inference Rate When Not Aiming
inference_backend_desc: Select execution provider preference (falls back automatically)
target_priority_mode_desc: How to select the best target
preview_crop_desc: Preview window shows only the AI detection region
kalman_enabled_desc: 2D Kalman filter for smooth, lag-free aim-point tracking
kalman_meas_noise_desc: Higher = smoother but slower to react; lower = trusts each detection more
makcu_key_inference_desc: Hold this mouse button to activate inference
pid_unsafe_mode_desc: Let the P (reaction speed) sliders be dragged past the proven-stable 0.50 cap, up to 1.00. Higher values can cause oscillation/overshoot — tune carefully.
fov_shrink_mode_desc: Fixed: always shrink to FOV Min Size. Adaptive: shrink while the target is steady,
fov_dynamic_safeguards_desc: Dynamic mode only. Never shrink past what the target's distance from the FOV edge allows, and don't trust speed/direction until the lock has settled (about 0.5 s).
fov_retention_desc: Keep tracking a locked target that drifts outside the shrunk FOV (no aiming there) instead of dropping it. Needs Sticky Target Lock. Rivals can't take the lock meanwhile.
fov_retention_pct_desc: How far outside the shrunk FOV a lock is kept, as % of FOV Size/Height. 100% = the full original FOV.
fov_expand_delay_desc: After the lock is released, wait this long before the FOV starts growing back. Controls WHEN recovery begins.
fov_recovery_duration_desc: How long the FOV takes to grow from its minimum back to full size (also the speed limit for Adaptive/Dynamic expansion). Controls HOW FAST it recovers. 0 = instant.
min_lock_duration_desc: A lock can't be swapped for another target sooner than this after it was acquired. Never delays releasing a target that is really gone.
tracking_needs_sticky_desc: Keeping a lock outside the shrunk FOV needs Sticky Target Lock - turn it on under Target Tracking on the Aim page, where the other lock settings are too.
tracking_confidence_desc: Minimum confidence to KEEP an existing lock. A new target still needs Min Confidence (Inference page, General Parameters), so a lock survives brief confidence dips. 0 = same as Min Confidence.
target_switch_threshold_desc: How much better (as a % of the priority score) another target must be before it replaces the current one. 100% = never switch while the current target is visible.
reacquire_radius_desc: A target reappearing within this distance of where the lost one was last seen (extrapolated by its velocity) is treated as the same target.
lost_target_timeout_desc: Longest time without a valid detection before the lock is released and the target forgotten. Aim is held only for Lock Persistence (which is capped by this); the target stays reacquirable until this elapses. Anchor FOV's FOV Lost Delay (Inference page) is separate and only delays the FOV.
lock_persistence_desc: How long aim is held after the target is lost before the lock is released (time-based, so it behaves the same at any inference FPS). Never longer than Lost Target Timeout.
aim_adaptive_ratio_desc: Scale head ratio inversely with box size — keeps head aim accurate from close to long range.
aim_adaptive_ratio_ref_h_desc: Box height (px) where head ratio is nominal. Match to your typical close-range target.
aim_crouch_aspect_desc: box_w / box_h above which player is treated as crouching. Default 1.2×.
aim_custom_y_desc: 0% = top of box, 100% = bottom. ~20% = head, ~60% = body.
aim_ema_smoothing_desc: Smooths each mouse step after the PID. Separate from Estimator Smoothing (Anchor Estimator) and FOV Anchor Smoothing (Inference page)
aim_posture_aware_desc: Fall back to center-mass when box is wider than tall (crouch / slide / prone).
aim_target_class_ids_desc: Choose which detected classes count as a valid aim target (e.g. never aim at a teammate class). All checked = no restriction.
arduino_baud_rate_desc: ⚠ Must match the baud rate in your Arduino sketch
auto_fire_spray_desc: Hold fire while the crosshair is on target, and release when it leaves
box_corner_length_hint: Bracket arm length as % of the box's shorter side. Auto = 15% (6-24 px).
box_line_thickness_hint: Thickness of corner brackets and full boxes. Auto = 1-3 px by confidence.
cam_motion_comp_desc: Subtract per-frame global scene shift (phase correlation) from aim error to cancel camera shake.
chroma_box_speed_hint: Rainbow cycle speed for boxes inside FOV. 0 = off.
detect_mode_desc: What detection does while the aim key is not held. Full speed: keep detecting. Reduced speed: detect only at the interval below to save resources. Stop detecting: nothing runs until you aim.
dml_installed_inactive: ✓ Installed — set backend to DirectML to activate
dml_restart_required: ⚠ Restart required — DirectML takes effect on next launch
fov_circle_filter_desc: Only track targets inside the FOV ellipse — a circle when Width equals Height — instead of the full rectangular region
humanization_desc: Perturb the final mouse output to look less robotic. Operates only on dx/dy — never touches detection or PID state.
humanization_intensity_desc: 0% = robotic precision, 100% = fully human-like. Scales every effect below.
humanization_jitter_base_desc: Minimum jitter amplitude added every frame, in pixels.
humanization_jitter_scale_desc: Extra jitter added per pixel of movement, as % of movement size.
humanization_micro_jitter_desc: Small zero-mean noise added to every move, scaled by movement size.
humanization_micro_jitter_idle_desc: Also apply Micro-Jitter's tremor while the aim key is held but no target is locked, instead of holding perfectly still.
humanization_micro_stutter_desc: Occasional brief magnitude reduction, modeling muscle hesitation before committing to a move.
humanization_motion_variation_desc: Randomize output scale slightly each frame (mean-preserving, no drift).
humanization_motion_variation_range_desc: Random output-scale range applied each frame (mean-preserving).
humanization_reaction_skip_prob_desc: Probability per frame of skipping the mouse injection entirely.
humanization_reaction_variability_desc: Occasionally skip a frame's mouse injection to simulate human micro-hesitation. Adds real per-frame latency — off by default.
humanization_reset_desc: Reset the whole Humanization section — Intensity, every feature toggle, and every fine-tuning slider above — back to default values.
humanization_speed_shaping_desc: Compress small corrections and pass through large movements unmodified, like human fine-motor control.
humanization_speed_shaping_high_desc: Movements above this size pass through unmodified.
humanization_speed_shaping_low_desc: Movements below this size are compressed by the Low-Speed Factor.
humanization_speed_shaping_low_factor_de: Magnitude scale applied to movements below the Fine-Control Threshold.
humanization_stutter_max_desc: Upper bound of the stutter magnitude factor.
humanization_stutter_min_desc: Lower bound of the stutter magnitude factor.
humanization_stutter_prob_desc: Probability per frame of a brief magnitude reduction.
lock_iou_desc: Minimum overlap required to match the same target across frames
makcu_aim_mode_desc: Hold: aim while button held  |  Toggle: click to toggle aim on/off
makcu_always_aim_button_desc: Optional side mouse button that activates Always Aim
makcu_always_aim_mode_desc: Hold: always-aim while button held  |  Toggle: click to toggle always-aim on/off
makcu_disengage_delay_desc: Keep aiming after releasing the aim button (0 = off)
model_search_desc: Filter the model list below by filename
model_trt_convert_busy: A conversion is already running (or Convert could not start). Selected model is saved — finish/retry conversion on the Convert tab.
model_trt_engine_missing_desc: Redirecting to the Convert tab to build it — this can take 1-5 minutes. The model will switch over automatically once it's done.
pid_time_normalize_desc: Scale the P and I response by elapsed time so aim speed stays the same when the inference FPS changes. Off keeps the original per-frame feel; identical at 60 FPS.
prediction_adaptive_lead_desc: Stretch the time lead when the mouse is moving slowly
prediction_capture_timestamps_desc: Time each sample by when its frame was captured, not when it was processed
prediction_desc: Aim slightly ahead of a moving target: extrapolates its position forward by the Aim Lead Horizon.
prediction_ego_motion_comp_desc: Don't count the camera turn from our own mouse moves as target motion. Ignored while Camera Motion Compensation is on
prediction_history_desc: How many recent detections the Aim Lead velocity estimate uses. The Anchor method has its own Estimator History.
prediction_lsq_fit_desc: Fit the speed through every point in the history, not just the oldest and newest
prediction_max_vel_desc: Velocity spikes above this are treated as detection jumps and reset prediction
prediction_method_desc: Velocity, EMA, a rolling average of recent steps, or Anchor (predicts the target's box; tuned under Anchor Box Prediction on the Inference page)
remote_aim_button_desc: Remote mouse button that activates aiming
remote_btn_enable_desc: Get the GamepadEnhancer PC's mouse buttons over the ViGEm Network connection (same address and token); holding the chosen button engages aim
semantic_filter_desc: Discard trees, vehicles, and HUD elements by class name and geometry
show_advanced_settings_desc: Also show fine-tuning options. Hidden options keep their values.
show_aim_prediction_marker_hint: Draw a second marker at the locked target's post-prediction point (only while Target Tracking's prediction or Kalman is on)
show_anchor_debug_hint: Draw the predicted box, current and predicted centre, a direction arrow, velocity and prediction confidence for the locked target (needs Anchor Box Prediction on the Inference page)
show_stick_gauge_hint: Draw a circle showing the virtual stick position and dead zones (only with the vigem_network mouse method)
show_tracer_line_hint: Draw a line from screen center to each detected target
sticky_gap_extrapolate_desc: Keep aiming along the last velocity for a few missed frames
sticky_lock_desc: Lock onto a target and hold aim across short detection gaps.
thread_priority_desc: CPU priority for inference, capture and preprocess threads. Takes effect on next inference start.
tracer_from_bottom_hint: Start each tracer line at the bottom-center of the screen instead of the crosshair
trt_convert_hint: The engine is cached in trt_cache/. On the next app launch, TensorRT loads it in under a second instead of rebuilding.
trt_convert_reverted: Reverted to the previously loaded model: {name}
trt_log_placeholder: Conversion output will appear here. First build can take 1–5 minutes.
trt_not_installed: ✗ Not installed — falls back to CUDA/CPU
trt_precision_desc: FP16 is ~2× faster on RTX GPUs. FP32 is full precision. Either engine can be selected later with the model.
trt_provider_no_dll: ⚠ Provider present but TensorRT DLLs not found — install tensorrt-cu12 wheels
trt_source_model_desc: Select the .onnx model to compile into a TensorRT engine.
trt_workspace_desc: GPU memory budget for the build. Increase for larger models.
vigem_game_deadzone_desc: The game's own inner stick dead zone; small corrections are pushed past it so they still register (0 = off)
vigem_input_deadzone_desc: Stick values below this fraction of full travel are ignored (jitter filter)
vigem_release_ms_desc: Recenter the stick this long after the last aim move, so it never keeps drifting
web_control_connect_desc: Open this URL on the same PC, or on any device on your LAN.
web_control_desc: Let a browser on your LAN control main functions (always-aim, status) over a token-authenticated API.
web_control_port_desc: Port the control API listens on.
web_control_token_desc: Paste this into the web client so it's allowed to send commands.
web_esp_connect_desc: Open this URL on the same PC, or scan the QR from a phone on the same Wi-Fi.
web_esp_desc: Stream the ESP overlay to a browser on this PC or any device on your LAN.
web_esp_fps_desc: Most updates per second sent to the browser overlay. Real data only arrives as fast as detection runs.
web_esp_http_port_desc: Port for the overlay web page.
web_esp_ws_port_desc: Port for the live state stream.
model_empty_hint: No .onnx models found. Put them in the Model folder (Open Model Folder below), then reopen this page.
full_config_empty_hint: No saved configs yet. Use Create Config to save your current settings.
preset_empty_hint: No saved presets yet. Use Create Preset to save your current aim settings.
